verdict.rationale: Medusa publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0 Store API spec that powers its API reference docs, and it has dedicated Storefront Development Guides. Community comments corroborate the headless model and official Gatsby/Next.js starter kits, and the pricing page lists storefront hosting with custom storefront domains. The probe 404s only show the spec is not served at well-known docs paths, which does not contradict the GitHub-hosted spec. Missing for 10: substantive content from the storefront guides (only a page title is evidenced), and current first-party documentation of a frontend starter or framework (the starter-kit mention comes from an older community thread).
